subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Vulval and vaginal disorders: lichen, VIN, VaIN and cancers

steps.tx: **Lichen sclerosus** whitens the vulva and perianal skin in a figure of 8 with parchment thinning, intense itching, labial fusion and painful intercourse. Potent **clobetasol** tapered to maintenance controls symptoms, while biopsy shows hyperkeratosis and lifelong watch continues because **squamous cell carcinoma** complicates about 5 percent. Erosive lichen planus scars the vagina and lichen simplex thickens skin through the scratch cycle, each needing steroids of suitable strength. Vitiligo only depigments and needs reassurance, while moisturisers protect the barrier.
steps.say: Lichen sclerosus is the disease that bleaches the vulva white in a figure of 8 and thins the skin like parchment. Intense itching drives scratching while fusion narrows the opening and intercourse turns painful. Potent steroids calm the disease, but doctors maintain lifelong watch because cancer complicates a minority. Biopsy confirms doubtful cases while moisturisers soothe the barrier daily.

steps.tx: The illustration displays white **figure of 8 plaques** around the vulva with parchment thinning, purpuric spots and labial resorption, plus a biopsy inset showing **dermal hyalinization** with a lymphocytic band. **Lichen sclerosus** causes intense itching with architectural loss, and potent clobetasol tapered to maintenance controls it. For the exam, link the figure of 8 pattern to sclerosus rather than vitiligo, and remember lifelong surveillance because squamous carcinoma complicates about 5 percent. The biopsy inset fixes histology beside the clinical picture.
steps.say: In the illustration, white plaques are seen encircling vulva and anus like a figure of 8. The skin looks thin and crinkled while purple spots mark fragile vessels. A biopsy inset reveals pale altered dermis packed with immune cells. Examiners prize this pattern because it separates sclerosus from vitiligo, and it demands lifelong cancer watch.

steps.tx: **Vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia** splits into HPV driven warty disease in younger women and differentiated disease on a lichen background in older women, often multifocal and mapping acetowhite on vulvoscopy. Selected cases respond to imiquimod while laser or excision with mapping clears the field, and microinvasion at VIN 3 needs depth assessment. **Vaginal intraepithelial neoplasia** favours the vault after hysterectomy with HPV, treated by laser or upper vaginectomy. **Paget disease** looks eczema like and needs wide excision, while pigmented melanoma behaves aggressively.
steps.say: Vulvar premalignancy divides into warty HPV disease of younger women and differentiated disease on lichen in older women. Mapping charts the full extent because lesions spread across fields. Laser or excision is used to clear disease while microinvasion demands depth assessment. Vault lesions after hysterectomy and eczema like Paget disease are included to complete the spectrum.

steps.tx: **Vulvar cancer** is usually squamous carcinoma presenting as a pruritic ulcer in elderly women, staged surgically under FIGO. Sentinel nodes serve unifocal tumours under 4 cm, positive groins need dissection, and advanced disease needs radiochemotherapy. **Vaginal cancer** follows HPV at the vault after hysterectomy, treated by brachytherapy when early and exenteration for central recurrence. The **Bartholin gland** forms abscesses needing marsupialisation or Word catheter, while cysts over 40 need excision to rule out cancer. Persistent itch or ulcer needs early biopsy, and groin wounds need lymphoedema care.
steps.say: Vulvar cancer appears as a persistent itchy ulcer in elderly women. Surgical staging maps spread while sentinel nodes spare selected groins. Advanced disease needs combined radiation with chemotherapy. Vault cancers after hysterectomy need brachytherapy when early, while Bartholin lumps over forty demand excision.

steps.tx: The **Bartholin cyst** feels fluctuant posterolaterally, while Skene cysts sit paraurethrally, Gartner cysts sit anterolaterally, inclusion cysts follow episiotomy and lipoma or fibroma need simple excision. Cystocele and urethrocele mimic vaginal lumps, and the Q tip test detects urethral hypermobility. **Labial adhesions** in little girls separate with estrogen cream, straddle injuries form haematomas managed conservatively, and suspected abuse forbids repeated examinations. A **punch biopsy** stays mandatory for persistent ulcer, itch or pigment change, so thresholds for sampling stay low.
steps.say: Bartholin cysts are swellings placed posterolaterally while other vaginal cysts occupy their own typical sites. Prolapse can mimic a cyst, so examination separates the two confidently. Fused labia in little girls separate with estrogen cream while straddle haematomas heal conservatively. Any persistent ulcer, itch or pigment change is an indication for biopsy without delay.
